name: io.github.eason4kim-rocket/purify-feeds-mcp
title: Purify Security Feeds
description: Query live CISA KEV / EPSS / enriched vulnerability feeds with full per-record provenance and auditable feed versions.

environmentVariables.name: PURIFY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the public feeds gateway (issued manually during the pilot — open a GitHub issue to request one)

environmentVariables.name: PURIFY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Feeds API base URL (defaults to the public gateway https://feeds.verifly.pro/feeds-api)
